niche_preference_profile: Prefers interfaces with strong visual hierarchy, modular card-based grouping, and either dark high-contrast or light bright themes depending on whether the screen remains clean, structured, and visually focused. Consistently favors simplified compositions with fewer competing elements, clear focal areas, prominent highlighted cards or imagery, rounded modern components, and concise grouped information. Also prefers softer purple/blue accent usage over harsh or decorative treatments, and generally likes sleek modern app-like or analytical aesthetics over cluttered, fragmented, or conventional layouts.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers screens with a strong focal point, clear section emphasis, highlighted primary content, and reduced competition between elements.
Prefers modular card-based layouts with clearly grouped sections, structured containers, and separated content blocks rather than continuous lists or fragmented layouts.

Usually prefers simplified, spacious, distraction-reduced screens with fewer visible controls or details at once, though will accept denser dashboards when information is clearly structured and insight-rich.
Prefers strong, intentional theming—either dark high-contrast interfaces with vivid accents or light bright backgrounds—over washed-out, muddy, or weakly differentiated color treatments.
Prefers large highlighted cards, tiles, charts, product imagery, or album art that create obvious primary emphasis and stronger content presence.
Prefers modern UI components with rounded cards, circular or compact controls, visual depth, and polished app-like styling rather than flat, generic, or conventional elements.
Prefers purple, blue, cyan, or similarly cool accent treatments and subtle outlined selection states over harsher pink-red, teal-glow, or overly aggressive emphasis styles.
